name: whisper-small-malayalam
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-small (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A fine-tune of openai/whisper-small, not a new base model: same config.json, same tensor set - HF reports 241,734,912 parameters (0.242B) for both this repo and the base, so the 0.244B in the base record is that record's rounding, not a size difference. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Two caveats belong with the single WER row: the base cell is the card's own '~85%' estimate for an untuned whisper-small rather than a measured run under the same harness, and the card supersedes its own earlier numbers (47.8% WER / 13.6% CER) after finding the old evaluation truncated clips past ~9 s. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-06-11.

benchmarks.name: Common Voice 25 Malayalam test WER
benchmarks.config: Card 'Benchmark Results' table, column 'WER down': row 'openai/whisper-small (base) | 244M | ~85%' vs row 'sajilck/whisper-small-malayalam | 244M | 37.64%'. The base cell is the card's own tilde-prefixed estimate for an untuned whisper-small, not a measured run under the same harness - the weakest evidence in this batch. Lower is better, hence higher_is_better false. 37.64% is the CommonVoice 25 Malayalam test figure; the card's leakage-free multi-source set gives 43.5% WER / 7.3% CER, corrected from an earlier 47.8%/13.6% after a token-cap bug that cut clips over ~9 s.
